stages.title: Public initialization
stages.description: SmartTurn v3.2 provides the starting weights.

stages.title: CPU delivery
stages.description: Pause prefixes and clean mixed fine-tuning. This remains the served ONNX artifact.

stages.title: Recipe reconstruction
stages.description: Reconstruct the training recipe on the r3 manifest. B1 replicates across three seeds; the original Krisp gate fails.

stages.title: Whisper-base, 4 s
stages.description: A larger encoder with a shorter window improves the official metric. The historical Krisp gate fails.

stages.title: Cohere, frozen
stages.description: Change backbone and fit the EoT readout. This starts a separate capacity branch.

stages.title: Adapt the top layers
stages.description: Fine-tune the upper encoder layers under the same capacity experiment.

stages.title: LoRA across the encoder
stages.description: Rank-16 adapters across 48 layers. All three seeds pass recorded quality gates; CPU serving fails.

deployment.selection_rule: Lowest observed batch-1 waiting at <=5% cutoffs among accepted exports with a shared policy within 5% at batches 1/4/8; HTTP p95 breaks ties.
deployment.scope: Selected take-home deployments. Public policies fitted on inspected benchmark; not blind testing or production qualification.
deployment.http_method: Warm closed-loop full HTTP on one frozen training PCM16 payload; 400 requests at c1/4/8; sequential CPU/GPU sweeps on local desktop; no CPU quota. No concurrent-call capacity claim.
deployment.quality_method: Unmodified pinned English public harness, 200 ms score point. Displayed curves use batch 1. Its 5% policy also checked at batches 4 and 8 for GPU.
deployment.precision_method: Original frozen frontend, merged LoRA, mixed FP16 with FP32 normalizations/reductions and head, three batch profiles, builder level 4, zero auxiliary streams, stable CUDA graphs for batches 1..8.
